items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Dr. Edmund Shusian was affiliated because he was the one that recommended me to the club

ctx.x: No, I worked... I was on the boat lately with an outfit I had of my own. Made of outfit. And of... A party for... Dr. Edmund Shusian was affiliated because he was the one that recommended me to the club... The Christophers, the name of the club. They had a party for the benefit of underprivileged Jewish children, I think, or something like that. And I was engaged to play on the president for that occasion. And I played on the boat a couple times with Paul Barberin, but I never did make those excursions that you…
Did you ever work with Paul Barberin when he had a small New Orleans-style jazz band?
